academic.name: Lund University
academic.description: Collaboration with Prof. Paul Bourgine on advanced bone marrow modeling within the EU-funded BuonMarrow project, developing innovative in vitro platforms for hematopoietic stem cell research.

academic.name: TU Delft
academic.description: Partnership with Prof. Massimo Mastrangeli within the Horizon Europe PHOENIX project, jointly developing next-generation organ-on-chip platforms for neuro-muscular and cardiac disease modeling.

academic.name: IBEC — Institute for Bioengineering of Catalonia
academic.description: Collaboration with Prof. Javier Ramón-Azcón in the BuonMarrow project, combining microfluidic and bioengineering expertise to advance bone marrow-on-chip technologies.

academic.name: Imperial College London
academic.description: Joint research with Prof. Anna Randi on vascularized organ-on-chip models within a UK Medical Research Council (MRC)-funded project, focusing on endothelial biology and vascular tissue engineering.

research.name: Humanitas Research Hospital
research.description: Long-standing collaboration on liver and cardiac disease modeling. Joint projects with Prof. Ana Lleo De Nalda on cholangiocarcinoma-on-chip, and with Prof. Elisa Di Pasquale on cardiac models within the Horizon Europe PHOENIX project.

research.name: CNR @ San Raffaele Hospital
research.description: Collaboration with Dr. Vania Broccoli at the Institute of Neuroscience (CNR) within San Raffaele Hospital, focused on neuromuscular modeling and neurodegenerative disease research using organ-on-chip platforms.

research.name: IEO — European Institute of Oncology
research.description: Key partnership on immuno-oncology and tumor microenvironment modeling. Collaboration with Prof. Luigi Nezi on the gut-on-chip platform published in Nature Biomedical Engineering, and with Prof. Luisa Lanfrancone on tumor-on-chip models.

industry.name: BiomimX
industry.description: Spin-off company of Politecnico di Milano co-founded by MiMic Lab. BiomimX develops and commercializes the patented uBeat technology — mechanically active organ-on-chip platforms for drug discovery and preclinical testing.

industry.name: Chiesi Farmaceutici
industry.description: Collaboration on lung-on-chip models for the study of chronic respiratory diseases including COPD and asthma, combining Chiesi's pharmaceutical expertise with MiMic Lab's microfluidic platform technologies.

industry.name: Micronit
industry.description: Dutch leader in the development of microfluidic devices and partner in the Horizon Europe PHOENIX project. Micronit provides cutting-edge microfabrication capabilities for next-generation organ-on-chip platforms.

industry.name: Multi Channel Systems (MCS)
industry.description: World leader in electrophysiology recording systems and partner in the Horizon Europe PHOENIX project. MCS provides advanced multi-electrode array technology for real-time functional readouts in organ-on-chip models.
